report:
Reviewed the complete diagnostic_counts claim, eight ordinary implementation associations and ten ordinary tests after a fresh start following the evidence edits. There are no TODO/N/A entries.

Collection: parse/mod.rs turns malformed item syntax into Error items rather than an infrastructure exception; observe.rs walks those items and emits source diagnostics, reports incomplete expansion, walks expanded symbols, demands signatures, retains body result diagnostics and explicitly validates imports. uses.rs supplies unresolved-import diagnostics even without a consumer. check/sig.rs reports each signature diagnostic through the SignatureDiagnostic Salsa accumulator in diagnostic.rs; collect retrieves the check_crate accumulated emissions and appends them once to the separately collected body/parse/expansion/import diagnostics. Neither this collection nor rustc.rs parse performs value-based deduplication. rustc parsing appends each top-level source diagnostic, omits only recognized summary/failure-note records, and does not count child labels/notes as independent errors. Captured prepare/run in compile/mod.rs performs both compiler checks before expectation comparison; expected text is never an input to collection or matching. Captured annotations.rs defines applicability and keeps each ERROR/WARN occurrence separately.

Matching: observe.rs filters applicable diagnostic markers, constructs every severity-and-primary-location eligibility edge and uses augmenting paths. Assignment is indexed by diagnostic occurrence, so each marker consumes one diagnostic and every diagnostic must have an assignment. The recursive reassignment avoids greedy rejection. Unmatched markers, unmatched diagnostics and severity conflicts all return failure before snapshot comparison. An empty/empty set succeeds. The matcher borrows diagnostics immutably and tracks assignments separately; collect renders the original vector order afterward.

Test accounting: overlapping_locations_require_global_matching_and_exact_counts asserts the adversarial overlapping assignment succeeds and independently asserts extra diagnostics, missing diagnostics and severity mismatch fail. nested_macro_errors_match_invocations_and_multiple_errors_need_multiple_markers checks real rustc macro output and two errors on one line, then removes one marker and checks the exact mismatch count. primary_spans_and_ancestry_match_but_labels_and_children_do_not asserts one top-level diagnostic despite a child, two entries for identical JSON diagnostics and rejection of an unmarked locationless error. invalid_source_reaches_sage asserts the full body-check mismatch rendering and marker. signature_diagnostics_are_retained_once requests the broken signature from two callers while expecting exactly one unresolved-type diagnostic. unused_import_is_checked asserts a source resolution diagnostic for an otherwise unused import. malformed_body_is_not_silently_accepted asserts malformed syntax reaches the Sage marker mismatch path rather than infrastructure failure. incomplete_expansion_is_a_source_diagnostic checks the same distinction for an unresolved macro, including the expansion diagnostic text. matching_preserves_identical_diagnostics_and_output_order checks three separate same-location occurrences, including two equal values, require three markers and retain render order. matching_snapshot_cannot_hide_missing_diagnostic supplies an empty expectation exactly matching actual diagnostic output but requires the unfulfilled ERROR marker to fail preparation. The shared immutable matcher and the directly inspected preparation barrier apply that snapshot-independent rejection equally to extras and severity mismatches already exercised by the matcher test.

Validation executed: cargo test -p sage-test-harness --lib --test compile_tests --test review_semantics passed 131 library, 14 integration and 8 review-semantics tests before the three additions. cargo test -p sage-test-harness --lib diagnostic_count_review_tests then passed all three additions. cargo fmt and cargo build completed successfully. Test results supplement source inspection; they are not treated as proof of the claim. The added tests and two essential helper implementation associations close the identified evidence gaps without changing production behavior. Independent post-codegen and Sage sanity checks are coordinated by the parent agent as separate work.
